rationale: Identity was correctly verified via name+ZIP. However, the agent performed multiple order-changing actions without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation (policy violation). It also canceled order #W2575533, which, per the order details shown, did not contain a garden hose, contradicting the user’s request to cancel only the hose item (and not to cancel anything else if item-level cancellation wasn’t possible). Additionally, the refund breakdown included an unsupported, likely fabricated total for the cancelled order and thus an incorrect grand total. These constitute acting without confirmation, canceling the wrong order, and providing unsupported information—failing the pass criteria.
